config.notes: UNBC (unbc.ca), text only, no page JSON. Page kinds: (a) academic calendar pages /calendar/undergraduate|graduate/... (most of the 47 read pages) carry programme rules only - no intakes, fees or English; (b) marketing programme pages /programs-and-admissions/undergraduate/programs/... carry a facts block (Campus, Duration, Intakes "Jan, May, Sep") and an "Approximate costs per academic year" table Domestic | International, tuition based on 30 credit hours: fee = the International tuition column (annual); (c) department pages (e.g. /engineering/meng-...) carry "Duration: 12 - 24 months Year Starts: September International Applications Accepted: Yes Location: Prince George, British Columbia" but no fee amount. Campus is read only from the facts block (site-wide "Prince George campus" text is ignored). No page carries IELTS. Central sources: English https://www.unbc.ca/calendar/undergraduate/international-admissions and https://www.unbc.ca/admissions/graduate/english-language-proficiency (IELTS 6.5, no band below 6.0; MEng Integrated Wood Design 7.0/6.5); semesters https://www.unbc.ca/calendar/undergraduate/semester-dates (September, January, May semesters); graduate intakes by programme https://unbc.ca/admissions/graduate/late-applications.
